decisions.reason: The expanded product coverage explicitly applies to TikTok Shop. Mentioning a website column in the tracking spreadsheet does not require publishing all products to the website.

The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the required existing spreadsheet and separate TikTok Shop and website tracking fields. Expanding TikTok listing coverage does not change the spreadsheet mechanism itself.
Listing all selected products on TikTok Shop does not change the existing CJ product research or selection criteria.
The TikTok Shop product-coverage decision is unrelated to daily Airbnb host outreach.
The source decision does not alter how interested Airbnb host conversations are advanced.
The source changes a specific TikTok listing requirement but does not change the general assignment-completion rules, assignment deadline, or current assignment set.
The product-listing coverage decision does not modify the fallback behavior for independently selecting available work.
The product-listing spreadsheet is distinct from the spreadsheet used to track interested Airbnb leads.
